metadata.title: Tri Tue Viet Tutoring Centre — 1-on-1, small group and online
metadata.description: Tri Tue Viet tutors students from grade 1 to 12 across every school subject and programming — personalised learning paths, dedicated tutors, clear progress reports.

hero.title: A learning path that fits, with progress you can see
hero.subtitle: Tri Tue Viet builds an individual plan for every student — advice matched to their level, the right class, and regular progress reports for parents.

courses.title: Courses by subject and grade
courses.description: Open to students from grade 1 to 12 across every school subject, plus programming courses from first steps to competitive and career tracks.

items.name: Natural sciences
items.description: Maths, Physics, Chemistry, Biology and General Science — aligned with the national curriculum, the grade 10 entrance exam and the graduation exam.

items.name: Social sciences
items.description: Literature, History, Geography and Civics — reading comprehension, argumentative writing and exam technique for the current format.

items.name: Foreign languages
items.description: English from the ground up through to exam skills; other languages arranged on request.

items.name: Programming basics
items.description: Algorithmic thinking and a first programming language, starting from zero at each student's own pace.

items.name: Competitive programming
items.description: Algorithms and data structures for informatics olympiad candidates and programming contests.

items.name: Programming for work
items.description: A path for people already working or moving into software, structured around the job they are aiming for.

formats.title: Pick the format that suits your child
formats.description: Four formats, the same tutor quality and the same progress reporting.

items.name: One-on-one
items.description: The tutor focuses entirely on one student and adjusts pace lesson by lesson.

items.name: Small group of 3 – 6
items.description: More affordable, still closely supervised, with peer motivation added.

items.name: Online classes
items.description: Live lessons with recordings, suited to distance or a busy schedule.

items.name: Home tutoring
items.description: The tutor comes to your home on a schedule you set.

process.title: Four steps to your child's first lesson
process.description: Nothing is charged until you are happy with the trial lesson.

steps.title: Get in touch for advice
steps.description: Leave your details and we call back within 24 hours, or reach us on Zalo or the hotline for advice straight away.

steps.title: Talk through where they are
steps.description: We listen as you describe your child's current level and goals, right there in the consultation — a conversation, not an exam.

steps.title: Match a class and a tutor
steps.description: You can name a tutor or set your own requirements; we match accordingly, along with the right learning format.

steps.title: Trial lesson and follow-up
steps.description: A free trial lesson, then regular progress reports sent to you.

teachers.title: The tutors your child will work with
teachers.description: Every tutor passes a subject interview and a trial lesson before taking a class.

plans.name: Working adults
features: A path built around your job goal
One-on-one or small group, as you prefer

items.quote: I had been round a great many tutoring centres before this one, but your tutors are the most dedicated I have found — sometimes they teach well past the hour and I have to go up and hurry them along so Quân can get his shower.
items.author: Nguyễn Mai Hoa

items.quote: The tutor knows the subject very broadly, and beyond that they teach my child how to think a problem through — how to sort a question into its type and find a way into it. It is done really well.
items.author: Phạm Thu Hà

items.quote: My child can be lazy about studying, but you found her a tutor she took to straight away. After a month the two of them are inseparable and she will study absolutely anywhere. More than once I have seen her ring Huyền, her tutor, outside lesson hours just to chat away…
items.author: Nguyễn Thị Linh
items.role: Parent of Nguyễn Thị Ánh Tuyết

items.question: Is the trial lesson charged?
items.answer: No. The first trial lesson is free; you only pay once you decide to enrol.

items.question: How is progress reported?
items.answer: Parents receive regular reports covering homework completion, test scores and the tutor's comments.

items.question: Can we change tutor if it is not a good fit?
items.answer: Yes. Tell us and we will arrange a different tutor at no extra cost.

items.question: Which platform do online classes use?
items.answer: Lessons run live on Google Meet, Microsoft Teams or Zoom, whichever your child is already comfortable with. Every session is recorded, so they can go back over it whenever they need.

items.question: How is tuition paid?
items.answer: It depends on the grade and the format your child is enrolled in, so there is no single schedule that fits everyone. Contact us and we will talk you through the option that suits you best.
